cond_0001.intro: The Senior Manufacturing Engineer is a subject matter expert (SME) for manufacturing processes of precision machined components. This role is responsible for the development of manufacturing methods and operation sheets created through the translation of customer technical data, specifications, and contracts. As a SME, this role will peer review the work of others, provide troubleshooting support to operations, and make judgement decisions as it pertains to the interpretation of customer/industry specification and standards. When needed this role will develop new advanced manufacturing methods through research of new equipment, technologies, methodologies, work holding and latest cutting tools.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Read and interpret customer specifications for material properties, special processes (finishes, coatings, heat-treatments, etc.), part marking, geometric tolerances (GD&T), and other critical to quality features to manufacture the component.
Create 3D models, 2D operational sheets and associated technical instructions to manufacture customer components according to specifications.
Work with multiple sources of manufacturing and design data (ERP, MRP, CAD, CAM, CNC, etc.) to develop a complete and fully released engineering technical package to production floor (e.g.: Op Sheets / Traveler). Ensure manufacturing software (ERP/MRP) mirrors CAD data, bill of materials, and method sequence.
Peer review of others work for compliance prior to release jobs to production.
Adhere to engineering change management (ECO/ECR/ECN), control, and documentation standards.
Real-time troubleshooting manufacturing issues on production floor.
Evaluate potential non-conforming parts against customer specifications to make the necessary judge call to process as-is, rework parts, or scrap component/job.
Optimize process cost, and costs components - labor, material, set-up, machine, inspection, etc.
Conduct research through webinars, journals, periodicals, tradeshows, and apply lessons learn to the business. Provide training and peer support as the SME to provide a transfer of knowledge.
Identify inefficiencies in a process; use leans tools and methodology to improve a process.
Miscellaneous duties as assigned.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
10+ Years' experience in manufacturing in a machining or contract manufacturing environment.
Subject expertise to read and enforce Aerospace customer blueprint/GD&T standards, special process specifications, raw material specification, and associated industry standards.
Expertise at developing process sheets in one or more of the following manufacturing methods – multi-axis turning, Swiss screw, turning, multi-axis milling and/or grinding.
Strong knowledge of manufacturing with advanced, difficult to machine, alloys to precision tolerances (0.0001""), and how that applies to manufacturing method, work holding, tooling selection, fixturing, and development of size over the progressive operation sequence.
Demonstrated ability to create 3D models, 2D process sheets and supporting technical data.
Proficient with database tools for file management and information technology tools for data collection and analysis such as ERP, MRP or PDM systems.
Preferred Requirements
Associate degree in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, or mechanical engineering.
Certified Manufacturing Engineering through Society of Manufacturing Engineers or progressive work experience commensurate with degree also considered.
Previous experience with RTX customers such as Collins Aerospace, Hamilton Sundstrand, Pratt & Whitney. Other OEM such as GE, Kaman, Sikorsky, etc., all considered.
SolidWorks experience.
[Product name masked] ERP and SolidWorks EPDM experience.

cond_0009.intro: We are looking for a Senior Manufacturing Engineer to join our team. cond_0041.intro: The Senior Manufacturing Engineer is a subject matter expert (SME) for manufacturing processes of precision machined components. This role is responsible for the development of manufacturing methods and operation sheets created through the translation of customer technical data, specifications, and contracts. As a SME, this role will peer review the work of others, provide troubleshooting support to operations, and make judgement decisions as it pertains to the interpretation of customer/industry specification and standards. When needed this role will develop new advanced manufacturing methods through research of new equipment, technologies, methodologies, work holding and latest cutting tools. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with precision machining processes and customer specification requirements.
cond_0041.responsibilities:
Read and interpret customer specifications for material properties, special processes (finishes, coatings, heat-treatments, etc.), part marking, geometric tolerances (GD&T), and other critical to quality features to manufacture the component.
Create 3D models, 2D operational sheets and associated technical instructions to manufacture customer components according to specifications.
Work with multiple sources of manufacturing and design data (ERP, MRP, CAD, CAM, CNC, etc.) to develop a complete and fully released engineering technical package to production floor (e.g.: Op Sheets / Traveler). Ensure manufacturing software (ERP/MRP) mirrors CAD data, bill of materials, and method sequence.
Peer review of others work for compliance prior to release jobs to production.
Adhere to engineering change management (ECO/ECR/ECN), control, and documentation standards.
Real-time troubleshooting manufacturing issues on production floor.
Evaluate potential non-conforming parts against customer specifications to make the necessary judge call to process as-is, rework parts, or scrap component/job.
Optimize process cost, and costs components - labor, material, set-up, machine, inspection, etc.
Conduct research through webinars, journals, periodicals, tradeshows, and apply lessons learn to the business. Provide training and peer support as the SME to provide a transfer of knowledge.
Identify inefficiencies in a process; use leans tools and methodology to improve a process.
Miscellaneous duties as assigned.
cond_0041.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
10+ Years' experience in manufacturing in a machining or contract manufacturing environment.
Subject expertise to read and enforce Aerospace customer blueprint/GD&T standards, special process specifications, raw material specification, and associated industry standards.
Expertise at developing process sheets in one or more of the following manufacturing methods – multi-axis turning, Swiss screw, turning, multi-axis milling and/or grinding.
Strong knowledge of manufacturing with advanced, difficult to machine, alloys to precision tolerances (0.0001""), and how that applies to manufacturing method, work holding, tooling selection, fixturing, and development of size over the progressive operation sequence.
Demonstrated ability to create 3D models, 2D process sheets and supporting technical data.
Proficient with database tools for file management and information technology tools for data collection and analysis such as ERP, MRP or PDM systems.
Preferred Requirements
Associate degree in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, or mechanical engineering.
Certified Manufacturing Engineering through Society of Manufacturing Engineers or progressive work experience commensurate with degree also considered.
Previous experience with RTX customers such as Collins Aerospace, Hamilton Sundstrand, Pratt & Whitney. Other OEM such as GE, Kaman, Sikorsky, etc., all considered.
SolidWorks experience.
[Product name masked] ERP and SolidWorks EPDM experience.

This role supports the development of manufacturing methods and operation sheets through collaboration on the translation of customer technical data, specifications, and contracts. As a SME, this role will peer review the work of others, provide troubleshooting support to operations, and work with the team to make judgement decisions on the interpretation of customer/industry specifications and standards. When needed, this role will coordinate research into new equipment, technologies, methodologies, work holding, and cutting tools to help develop advanced manufacturing methods.
cond_0090.responsibilities:
Read and interpret customer specifications for material properties, special processes (finishes, coatings, heat-treatments, etc.), part marking, geometric tolerances (GD&T), and other critical to quality features to help manufacture the component.
Coordinate with production and engineering teams to create 3D models, 2D operational sheets, and associated technical instructions to manufacture customer components according to specifications.
Work with multiple sources of manufacturing and design data (ERP, MRP, CAD, CAM, CNC, etc.) to help develop a complete and fully released engineering technical package to the production floor (e.g.: Op Sheets / Traveler). Help ensure manufacturing software (ERP/MRP) mirrors CAD data, bill of materials, and method sequence.
Peer review others' work for compliance prior to releasing jobs to production.
Adhere to engineering change management (ECO/ECR/ECN), control, and documentation standards.
Support real-time troubleshooting of manufacturing issues on the production floor.
Work alongside quality and production teams to evaluate potential non-conforming parts against customer specifications and determine whether to process as-is, rework parts, or scrap component/job.
Collaborate on process cost optimization, including labor, material, set-up, machine, inspection, etc.
Conduct research through webinars, journals, periodicals, and tradeshows, and share lessons learned with the team. Provide training and peer support as the SME to facilitate transfer of knowledge.
Identify inefficiencies in a process; work with the team using lean tools and methodology to improve the process.
Miscellaneous duties as assigned.
cond_0090.requirements:
Associate degree in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, or mechanical engineering preferred.
Certified Manufacturing Engineering through Society of Manufacturing Engineers or progressive work experience commensurate with degree also considered.
10+ Years' experience in manufacturing in a machining or contract manufacturing environment.
Subject expertise to read and enforce Aerospace customer blueprint/GD&T standards, special process specifications, raw material specification, and associated industry standards.
Previous experience with RTX customers such as Collins Aerospace, Hamilton Sundstrand, Pratt & Whitney, preferable. Other OEM such as GE, Kaman, Sikorsky, etc., all considered.
Expertise at developing process sheets in one or more of the following manufacturing methods – multi-axis turning, Swiss screw, turning, multi-axis milling and/or grinding.
Strong knowledge of manufacturing with advanced, difficult to machine, alloys to precision tolerances (0.0001""), and how that applies to manufacturing method, work holding, tooling selection, fixturing, and development of size over the progressive operation sequence.
Demonstrated ability to create 3D models, 2D process sheets and supporting technical data. SolidWorks preferred.
Proficient with database tools for file management and information technology tools for data collection and analysis such as ERP, MRP or PDM systems. [Product name masked] ERP and SolidWorks EPDM a plus.
cond_0090.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0090.values: We value having a positive impact on the people our work affects. We aim to act with responsibility, fairness, and respect in the way we make decisions and deliver our work.
cond_0090.workplace_support: We are committed to creating a workplace where people can grow, connect, and build their careers with confidence. Employees have access to knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and career-development resources designed to support growth over time.

This role supports the development of manufacturing methods and operation sheets through collaboration on the translation of customer technical data, specifications, and contracts. As a SME, this role will peer review the work of others, provide troubleshooting support to operations, and work with the team to make judgement decisions on the interpretation of customer/industry specifications and standards. When needed, this role will coordinate research into new equipment, technologies, methodologies, work holding, and cutting tools to help develop advanced manufacturing methods.
cond_0108.responsibilities:
Read and interpret customer specifications for material properties, special processes (finishes, coatings, heat-treatments, etc.), part marking, geometric tolerances (GD&T), and other critical to quality features to help manufacture the component.
Coordinate with production and engineering teams to create 3D models, 2D operational sheets, and associated technical instructions to manufacture customer components according to specifications.
Work with multiple sources of manufacturing and design data (ERP, MRP, CAD, CAM, CNC, etc.) to help develop a complete and fully released engineering technical package to the production floor (e.g.: Op Sheets / Traveler). Help ensure manufacturing software (ERP/MRP) mirrors CAD data, bill of materials, and method sequence.
Peer review others' work for compliance prior to releasing jobs to production.
Adhere to engineering change management (ECO/ECR/ECN), control, and documentation standards.
Support real-time troubleshooting of manufacturing issues on the production floor.
Work alongside quality and production teams to evaluate potential non-conforming parts against customer specifications and determine whether to process as-is, rework parts, or scrap component/job.
Collaborate on process cost optimization, including labor, material, set-up, machine, inspection, etc.
Conduct research through webinars, journals, periodicals, and tradeshows, and share lessons learned with the team. Provide training and peer support as the SME to facilitate transfer of knowledge.
Identify inefficiencies in a process; work with the team using lean tools and methodology to improve the process.
Miscellaneous duties as assigned.
cond_0108.requirements:
Associate degree in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, or mechanical engineering preferred.
Certified Manufacturing Engineering through Society of Manufacturing Engineers or progressive work experience commensurate with degree also considered.
10+ Years' experience in manufacturing in a machining or contract manufacturing environment.
Subject expertise to read and enforce Aerospace customer blueprint/GD&T standards, special process specifications, raw material specification, and associated industry standards.
Previous experience with RTX customers such as Collins Aerospace, Hamilton Sundstrand, Pratt & Whitney, preferable. Other OEM such as GE, Kaman, Sikorsky, etc., all considered.
Expertise at developing process sheets in one or more of the following manufacturing methods – multi-axis turning, Swiss screw, turning, multi-axis milling and/or grinding.
Strong knowledge of manufacturing with advanced, difficult to machine, alloys to precision tolerances (0.0001""), and how that applies to manufacturing method, work holding, tooling selection, fixturing, and development of size over the progressive operation sequence.
Demonstrated ability to create 3D models, 2D process sheets and supporting technical data. SolidWorks preferred.
Proficient with database tools for file management and information technology tools for data collection and analysis such as ERP, MRP or PDM systems. [Product name masked] ERP and SolidWorks EPDM a plus.
cond_0108.values: We value having a positive impact on the people our work affects. We aim to act with responsibility, fairness, and respect in the way we make decisions and deliver our work.
cond_0108.workplace_support: We are committed to creating a workplace where people can grow, connect, and build their careers with confidence. Employees have access to knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and career-development resources designed to support growth over time.

cond_0133.intro: The Senior Manufacturing Engineer is a subject matter expert (SME) for manufacturing processes of precision machined components. This role is responsible for developing manufacturing methods and operation sheets through the translation of customer technical data, specifications, and contracts. As an SME, this role peer reviews the work of others, provides troubleshooting support to operations, and makes judgment decisions on the interpretation of customer and industry specifications and standards. When needed, this role develops new advanced manufacturing methods through research of new equipment, technologies, methodologies, work holding, and cutting tools.
cond_0133.responsibilities:
Read and interpret customer specifications for material properties, special processes (finishes, coatings, heat-treatments, etc.), part marking, geometric tolerances (GD&T), and other critical-to-quality features required to manufacture the component.
Create 3D models, 2D operational sheets, and associated technical instructions to manufacture customer components according to specifications.
Work with multiple sources of manufacturing and design data (ERP, MRP, CAD, CAM, CNC, etc.) to develop a complete and fully released engineering technical package for the production floor (e.g., Op Sheets / Traveler). Ensure manufacturing software (ERP/MRP) mirrors CAD data, bill of materials, and method sequence.
Peer review others' work for compliance prior to releasing jobs to production.
Adhere to engineering change management (ECO/ECR/ECN), control, and documentation standards.
Provide real-time troubleshooting of manufacturing issues on the production floor.
Evaluate potential non-conforming parts against customer specifications to determine whether to process as-is, rework, or scrap the component or job.
Optimize process cost and cost components — labor, material, set-up, machine, inspection, etc.
Conduct research through webinars, journals, periodicals, and tradeshows; apply lessons learned to the business. Provide training and knowledge transfer to others as the SME.
Identify inefficiencies in a process; use lean tools and methodology to improve the process.
Miscellaneous duties as assigned.
cond_0133.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
10+ Years of experience in manufacturing in a machining or contract manufacturing environment.
Subject expertise to read and enforce aerospace customer blueprint/GD&T standards, special process specifications, raw material specifications, and associated industry standards.
Expertise in developing process sheets in one or more of the following manufacturing methods: multi-axis turning, Swiss screw, turning, multi-axis milling, and/or grinding.
Strong knowledge of manufacturing with advanced, difficult-to-machine alloys to precision tolerances (0.0001""), and how that applies to manufacturing method, work holding, tooling selection, fixturing, and development of size over the progressive operation sequence.
Demonstrated ability to create 3D models, 2D process sheets, and supporting technical data.
Proficient with database tools for file management and information technology tools for data collection and analysis such as ERP, MRP, or PDM systems.
Preferred Requirements
Associate degree in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, or mechanical engineering.
Certified Manufacturing Engineer through the Society of Manufacturing Engineers, or progressive work experience commensurate with a degree.
Previous experience with RTX customers such as Collins Aerospace, Hamilton Sundstrand, or Pratt & Whitney. Other OEMs such as GE, Kaman, or Sikorsky also considered.
SolidWorks proficiency.
Experience with [Product name masked] ERP and SolidWorks EPDM.

cond_0150.intro: The Senior Manufacturing Engineer is a subject matter expert (SME) for manufacturing processes of precision machined components. This role is responsible for developing manufacturing methods and operation sheets through the translation of customer technical data, specifications, and contracts. As a SME, you will regularly peer review the work of others, stay in close contact with operations to provide troubleshooting support, and make judgement calls on the interpretation of customer and industry specifications and standards. When needed, you will develop new advanced manufacturing methods by researching new equipment, technologies, methodologies, work holding, and cutting tools.
cond_0150.responsibilities:
Read and interpret customer specifications for material properties, special processes (finishes, coatings, heat-treatments, etc.), part marking, geometric tolerances (GD&T), and other critical-to-quality features to manufacture the component.
Create 3D models, 2D operational sheets, and associated technical instructions to manufacture customer components according to specifications.
Work with multiple sources of manufacturing and design data (ERP, MRP, CAD, CAM, CNC, etc.) to develop a complete and fully released engineering technical package to the production floor (e.g., Op Sheets / Traveler). Ensure manufacturing software (ERP/MRP) mirrors CAD data, bill of materials, and method sequence.
Actively peer review others' work for compliance and speak up on any issues prior to releasing jobs to production.
Adhere to engineering change management (ECO/ECR/ECN), control, and documentation standards.
Provide real-time troubleshooting on the production floor, connecting directly with operators and production staff to resolve manufacturing issues as they arise.
Evaluate potential non-conforming parts against customer specifications and make the necessary judgement call to process as-is, rework parts, or scrap the component/job.
Optimize process cost and cost components — labor, material, set-up, machine, inspection, etc.
Conduct research through webinars, journals, periodicals, and tradeshows, and apply lessons learned to the business. Provide training and peer support as the SME to transfer knowledge across the team.
Identify inefficiencies in a process; use lean tools and methodology to improve a process.
Miscellaneous duties as assigned.
cond_0150.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
10+ Years of experience in manufacturing in a machining or contract manufacturing environment.
Subject expertise to read and enforce aerospace customer blueprint/GD&T standards, special process specifications, raw material specifications, and associated industry standards.
Expertise in developing process sheets in one or more of the following manufacturing methods: multi-axis turning, Swiss screw, turning, multi-axis milling, and/or grinding.
Strong knowledge of manufacturing with advanced, difficult-to-machine alloys to precision tolerances (0.0001""), and how that applies to manufacturing method, work holding, tooling selection, fixturing, and development of size over the progressive operation sequence.
Demonstrated ability to create 3D models, 2D process sheets, and supporting technical data.
Proficient with database tools for file management and information technology tools for data collection and analysis such as ERP, MRP, or PDM systems.
Preferred Requirements
Associate degree in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, or mechanical engineering.
Certified Manufacturing Engineer through the Society of Manufacturing Engineers, or progressive work experience commensurate with a degree.
Previous experience with RTX customers such as Collins Aerospace, Hamilton Sundstrand, or Pratt & Whitney. Other OEMs such as GE, Kaman, Sikorsky, etc., also considered.
SolidWorks proficiency.
[Product name masked] ERP and SolidWorks EPDM experience.

This role is responsible for the development of manufacturing methods and operation sheets created through the translation of customer technical data, specifications, and contracts. As a SME, this role will peer review the work of others, provide troubleshooting support to operations, and make judgement decisions as it pertains to the interpretation of customer/industry specification and standards. When needed this role will develop new advanced manufacturing methods through research of new equipment, technologies, methodologies, work holding and latest cutting tools. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of precision machining processes and how they connect to customer specifications.
cond_0193.responsibilities:
Read and interpret customer specifications for material properties, special processes (finishes, coatings, heat-treatments, etc.), part marking, geometric tolerances (GD&T), and other critical to quality features to manufacture the component.
Create 3D models, 2D operational sheets and associated technical instructions to manufacture customer components according to specifications.
Work with multiple sources of manufacturing and design data (ERP, MRP, CAD, CAM, CNC, etc.) to develop a complete and fully released engineering technical package to production floor (e.g.: Op Sheets / Traveler). Ensure manufacturing software (ERP/MRP) mirrors CAD data, bill of materials, and method sequence.
Peer review of others work for compliance prior to release jobs to production.
Adhere to engineering change management (ECO/ECR/ECN), control, and documentation standards.
Real-time troubleshooting manufacturing issues on production floor.
Evaluate potential non-conforming parts against customer specifications to make the necessary judge call to process as-is, rework parts, or scrap component/job.
Optimize process cost, and costs components - labor, material, set-up, machine, inspection, etc.
Conduct research through webinars, journals, periodicals, tradeshows, and apply lessons learn to the business. Provide training and peer support as the SME to provide a transfer of knowledge.
Identify inefficiencies in a process; use leans tools and methodology to improve a process.
Miscellaneous duties as assigned.
cond_0193.requirements:
Associate degree in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, or mechanical engineering preferred.
Certified Manufacturing Engineering through Society of Manufacturing Engineers or progressive work experience commensurate with degree also considered.
10+ Years' experience in manufacturing in a machining or contract manufacturing environment.
Subject expertise to read and enforce Aerospace customer blueprint/GD&T standards, special process specifications, raw material specification, and associated industry standards.
Previous experience with RTX customers such as Collins Aerospace, Hamilton Sundstrand, Pratt & Whitney, preferable. Other OEM such as GE, Kaman, Sikorsky, etc., all considered.
Expertise at developing process sheets in one or more of the following manufacturing methods – multi-axis turning, Swiss screw, turning, multi-axis milling and/or grinding.
Strong knowledge of manufacturing with advanced, difficult to machine, alloys to precision tolerances (0.0001""), and how that applies to manufacturing method, work holding, tooling selection, fixturing, and development of size over the progressive operation sequence.
Demonstrated ability to create 3D models, 2D process sheets and supporting technical data. SolidWorks preferred.
Proficient with database tools for file management and information technology tools for data collection and analysis such as ERP, MRP or PDM systems. [Product name masked] ERP and SolidWorks EPDM a plus.
cond_0193.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0253.intro: The Senior Manufacturing Engineer is a subject matter expert (SME) for manufacturing processes of precision machined components. This role is responsible for the development of manufacturing methods and operation sheets created through the translation of customer technical data, specifications, and contracts. As a SME, this role will peer review the work of others, provide troubleshooting support to operations, and make judgement decisions as it pertains to the interpretation of customer/industry specification and standards. When needed this role will develop new advanced manufacturing methods through research of new equipment, technologies, methodologies, work holding and latest cutting tools.
cond_0253.responsibilities:
Read and interpret customer specifications for material properties, special processes (finishes, coatings, heat-treatments, etc.), part marking, geometric tolerances (GD&T), and other critical to quality features to manufacture the component.
Create 3D models, 2D operational sheets and associated technical instructions to manufacture customer components according to specifications.
Work with multiple sources of manufacturing and design data (ERP, MRP, CAD, CAM, CNC, etc.) to develop a complete and fully released engineering technical package to production floor (e.g.: Op Sheets / Traveler). Ensure manufacturing software (ERP/MRP) mirrors CAD data, bill of materials, and method sequence.
Peer review of others work for compliance prior to release jobs to production.
Adhere to engineering change management (ECO/ECR/ECN), control, and documentation standards.
Real-time troubleshooting manufacturing issues on production floor.
Evaluate potential non-conforming parts against customer specifications to make the necessary judge call to process as-is, rework parts, or scrap component/job.
Optimize process cost, and costs components - labor, material, set-up, machine, inspection, etc.
Conduct research through webinars, journals, periodicals, tradeshows, and apply lessons learn to the business. Provide training and peer support as the SME to provide a transfer of knowledge.
Identify inefficiencies in a process; use leans tools and methodology to improve a process.
Miscellaneous duties as assigned.
cond_0253.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
10+ Years' experience in manufacturing in a machining or contract manufacturing environment.
Subject expertise to read and enforce Aerospace customer blueprint/GD&T standards, special process specifications, raw material specification, and associated industry standards.
Expertise at developing process sheets in one or more of the following manufacturing methods – multi-axis turning, Swiss screw, turning, multi-axis milling and/or grinding.
Strong knowledge of manufacturing with advanced, difficult to machine, alloys to precision tolerances (0.0001""), and how that applies to manufacturing method, work holding, tooling selection, fixturing, and development of size over the progressive operation sequence.
Demonstrated ability to create 3D models, 2D process sheets and supporting technical data.
Proficient with database tools for file management and information technology tools for data collection and analysis such as ERP, MRP or PDM systems.
Preferred Requirements
Associate degree in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, or mechanical engineering.
Certified Manufacturing Engineering through Society of Manufacturing Engineers or progressive work experience commensurate with degree also considered.
Previous experience with RTX customers such as Collins Aerospace, Hamilton Sundstrand, Pratt & Whitney. Other OEM such as GE, Kaman, Sikorsky, etc., all considered.
SolidWorks experience.
[Product name masked] ERP and SolidWorks EPDM experience.

cond_0311.intro: The Senior Manufacturing Engineer is a subject matter expert (SME) for manufacturing processes of precision machined components. This role is responsible for the development of manufacturing methods and operation sheets created through the translation of customer technical data, specifications, and contracts. As a SME, this role will peer review the work of others, provide troubleshooting support to operations, and make judgement decisions as it pertains to the interpretation of customer/industry specification and standards. When needed this role will develop new advanced manufacturing methods through research of new equipment, technologies, methodologies, work holding and latest cutting tools. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with precision machining processes and customer specification requirements.
cond_0311.responsibilities:
Read and interpret customer specifications for material properties, special processes (finishes, coatings, heat-treatments, etc.), part marking, geometric tolerances (GD&T), and other critical to quality features to manufacture the component.
Create 3D models, 2D operational sheets and associated technical instructions to manufacture customer components according to specifications.
Work with multiple sources of manufacturing and design data (ERP, MRP, CAD, CAM, CNC, etc.) to develop a complete and fully released engineering technical package to production floor (e.g.: Op Sheets / Traveler). Ensure manufacturing software (ERP/MRP) mirrors CAD data, bill of materials, and method sequence.
Peer review of others work for compliance prior to release jobs to production.
Adhere to engineering change management (ECO/ECR/ECN), control, and documentation standards.
Real-time troubleshooting manufacturing issues on production floor.
Evaluate potential non-conforming parts against customer specifications to make the necessary judge call to process as-is, rework parts, or scrap component/job.
Optimize process cost, and costs components - labor, material, set-up, machine, inspection, etc.
Conduct research through webinars, journals, periodicals, tradeshows, and apply lessons learn to the business. Provide training and peer support as the SME to provide a transfer of knowledge.
Identify inefficiencies in a process; use leans tools and methodology to improve a process.
Miscellaneous duties as assigned.

cond_0320.intro: The Senior Manufacturing Engineer is a subject matter expert (SME) for manufacturing processes of precision machined components. This role is responsible for the development of manufacturing methods and operation sheets created through the translation of customer technical data, specifications, and contracts. As a SME, this role will peer review the work of others, provide troubleshooting support to operations, and make judgement decisions as it pertains to the interpretation of customer/industry specification and standards. When needed this role will develop new advanced manufacturing methods through research of new equipment, technologies, methodologies, work holding and latest cutting tools. Most people become stronger in this work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0320.responsibilities:
Read and interpret customer specifications for material properties, special processes (finishes, coatings, heat-treatments, etc.), part marking, geometric tolerances (GD&T), and other critical to quality features to manufacture the component.
Create 3D models, 2D operational sheets and associated technical instructions to manufacture customer components according to specifications.
Work with multiple sources of manufacturing and design data (ERP, MRP, CAD, CAM, CNC, etc.) to develop a complete and fully released engineering technical package to production floor (e.g.: Op Sheets / Traveler). Ensure manufacturing software (ERP/MRP) mirrors CAD data, bill of materials, and method sequence.
Peer review of others work for compliance prior to release jobs to production.
Adhere to engineering change management (ECO/ECR/ECN), control, and documentation standards.
Real-time troubleshooting manufacturing issues on production floor.
Evaluate potential non-conforming parts against customer specifications to make the necessary judge call to process as-is, rework parts, or scrap component/job.
Optimize process cost, and costs components - labor, material, set-up, machine, inspection, etc.
Conduct research through webinars, journals, periodicals, tradeshows, and apply lessons learn to the business. Provide training and peer support as the SME to provide a transfer of knowledge.
Identify inefficiencies in a process; use leans tools and methodology to improve a process.
Miscellaneous duties as assigned.

cond_0371.intro: The Senior Manufacturing Engineer is a subject matter expert (SME) for manufacturing processes of precision machined components. This role is responsible for the development of manufacturing methods and operation sheets created through the translation of customer technical data, specifications, and contracts. As a SME, this role will peer review the work of others, provide troubleshooting support to operations, and make judgement decisions as it pertains to the interpretation of customer/industry specification and standards. When needed this role will develop new advanced manufacturing methods through research of new equipment, technologies, methodologies, work holding and latest cutting tools.
cond_0371.responsibilities:
Read and interpret customer specifications for material properties, special processes (finishes, coatings, heat-treatments, etc.), part marking, geometric tolerances (GD&T), and other critical to quality features to manufacture the component.
Create 3D models, 2D operational sheets and associated technical instructions to manufacture customer components according to specifications.
Work with multiple sources of manufacturing and design data (ERP, MRP, CAD, CAM, CNC, etc.) to develop a complete and fully released engineering technical package to production floor (e.g.: Op Sheets / Traveler). Ensure manufacturing software (ERP/MRP) mirrors CAD data, bill of materials, and method sequence.
Peer review of others work for compliance prior to release jobs to production.
Adhere to engineering change management (ECO/ECR/ECN), control, and documentation standards.
Real-time troubleshooting manufacturing issues on production floor.
Evaluate potential non-conforming parts against customer specifications to make the necessary judge call to process as-is, rework parts, or scrap component/job.
Optimize process cost, and costs components - labor, material, set-up, machine, inspection, etc.
Conduct research through webinars, journals, periodicals, tradeshows, and apply lessons learn to the business. Provide training and peer support as the SME to provide a transfer of knowledge.
Identify inefficiencies in a process; use leans tools and methodology to improve a process.
Miscellaneous duties as assigned.

cond_0379.intro: The Senior Manufacturing Engineer is a subject matter expert (SME) for manufacturing processes of precision machined components. This role is responsible for the development of manufacturing methods and operation sheets created through the translation of customer technical data, specifications, and contracts. As a SME, this role will peer review the work of others, provide troubleshooting support to operations, and make judgement decisions as it pertains to the interpretation of customer/industry specification and standards. When needed this role will develop new advanced manufacturing methods through research of new equipment, technologies, methodologies, work holding and latest cutting tools.
cond_0379.responsibilities:
Read and interpret customer specifications for material properties, special processes (finishes, coatings, heat-treatments, etc.), part marking, geometric tolerances (GD&T), and other critical to quality features to manufacture the component.
Create 3D models, 2D operational sheets and associated technical instructions to manufacture customer components according to specifications.
Work with multiple sources of manufacturing and design data (ERP, MRP, CAD, CAM, CNC, etc.) to develop a complete and fully released engineering technical package to production floor (e.g.: Op Sheets / Traveler). Ensure manufacturing software (ERP/MRP) mirrors CAD data, bill of materials, and method sequence.
Peer review of others work for compliance prior to release jobs to production.
Adhere to engineering change management (ECO/ECR/ECN), control, and documentation standards.
Real-time troubleshooting manufacturing issues on production floor.
Evaluate potential non-conforming parts against customer specifications to make the necessary judge call to process as-is, rework parts, or scrap component/job.
Optimize process cost, and costs components - labor, material, set-up, machine, inspection, etc.
Conduct research through webinars, journals, periodicals, tradeshows, and apply lessons learn to the business. Provide training and peer support as the SME to provide a transfer of knowledge.
Identify inefficiencies in a process; use leans tools and methodology to improve a process.
Miscellaneous duties as assigned.
cond_0379.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
10+ Years' experience in manufacturing in a machining or contract manufacturing environment.
Subject expertise to read and enforce Aerospace customer blueprint/GD&T standards, special process specifications, raw material specification, and associated industry standards.
Expertise at developing process sheets in one or more of the following manufacturing methods – multi-axis turning, Swiss screw, turning, multi-axis milling and/or grinding.
Strong knowledge of manufacturing with advanced, difficult to machine, alloys to precision tolerances (0.0001""), and how that applies to manufacturing method, work holding, tooling selection, fixturing, and development of size over the progressive operation sequence.
Demonstrated ability to create 3D models, 2D process sheets and supporting technical data.
Proficient with database tools for file management and information technology tools for data collection and analysis such as ERP, MRP or PDM systems.
Preferred Requirements
Associate degree in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, or mechanical engineering.
Certified Manufacturing Engineering through Society of Manufacturing Engineers or progressive work experience commensurate with degree also considered.
Previous experience with RTX customers such as Collins Aerospace, Hamilton Sundstrand, Pratt & Whitney. Other OEM such as GE, Kaman, Sikorsky, etc., all considered.
SolidWorks experience.
[Product name masked] ERP and SolidWorks EPDM experience.

As a SME, this role will peer review the work of others, provide troubleshooting support to operations, and make judgement decisions as it pertains to the interpretation of customer/industry specification and standards. When needed this role will develop new advanced manufacturing methods through research of new equipment, technologies, methodologies, work holding and latest cutting tools.
cond_0424.responsibilities:
Read and interpret customer specifications for material properties, special processes (finishes, coatings, heat-treatments, etc.), part marking, geometric tolerances (GD&T), and other critical to quality features to manufacture the component.
Create 3D models, 2D operational sheets and associated technical instructions to manufacture customer components according to specifications.
Work with multiple sources of manufacturing and design data (ERP, MRP, CAD, CAM, CNC, etc.) to develop a complete and fully released engineering technical package to production floor (e.g.: Op Sheets / Traveler). Ensure manufacturing software (ERP/MRP) mirrors CAD data, bill of materials, and method sequence.
Peer review of others work for compliance prior to release jobs to production.
Adhere to engineering change management (ECO/ECR/ECN), control, and documentation standards.
Real-time troubleshooting manufacturing issues on production floor.
Evaluate potential non-conforming parts against customer specifications to make the necessary judge call to process as-is, rework parts, or scrap component/job.
Optimize process cost, and costs components - labor, material, set-up, machine, inspection, etc.
Conduct research through webinars, journals, periodicals, tradeshows, and apply lessons learn to the business. Provide training and peer support as the SME to provide a transfer of knowledge.
Identify inefficiencies in a process; use leans tools and methodology to improve a process.
Miscellaneous duties as assigned.
cond_0424.requirements:
Associate degree in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, or mechanical engineering preferred.
Certified Manufacturing Engineering through Society of Manufacturing Engineers or progressive work experience commensurate with degree also considered.
10+ Years' experience in manufacturing in a machining or contract manufacturing environment.
Subject expertise to read and enforce Aerospace customer blueprint/GD&T standards, special process specifications, raw material specification, and associated industry standards.
Previous experience with RTX customers such as Collins Aerospace, Hamilton Sundstrand, Pratt & Whitney, preferable. Other OEM such as GE, Kaman, Sikorsky, etc., all considered.
Expertise at developing process sheets in one or more of the following manufacturing methods – multi-axis turning, Swiss screw, turning, multi-axis milling and/or grinding.
Strong knowledge of manufacturing with advanced, difficult to machine, alloys to precision tolerances (0.0001""), and how that applies to manufacturing method, work holding, tooling selection, fixturing, and development of size over the progressive operation sequence.
Demonstrated ability to create 3D models, 2D process sheets and supporting technical data. SolidWorks preferred.
Proficient with database tools for file management and information technology tools for data collection and analysis such as ERP, MRP or PDM systems. [Product name masked] ERP and SolidWorks EPDM a plus.
cond_0424.values: We value high performance and work that reflects care, discipline, and strong judgment. We believe results matter, and so does the standard behind them.

As a SME, this role will peer review the work of others, provide troubleshooting support to operations, and work with the team to make judgement decisions on the interpretation of customer/industry specifications and standards. When needed, this role will coordinate research into new equipment, technologies, methodologies, work holding, and cutting tools to help develop advanced manufacturing methods.
cond_0450.responsibilities:
Read and interpret customer specifications for material properties, special processes (finishes, coatings, heat-treatments, etc.), part marking, geometric tolerances (GD&T), and other critical to quality features to help manufacture the component.
Coordinate with production and engineering teams to create 3D models, 2D operational sheets, and associated technical instructions to manufacture customer components according to specifications.
Work with multiple sources of manufacturing and design data (ERP, MRP, CAD, CAM, CNC, etc.) to help develop a complete and fully released engineering technical package to the production floor (e.g.: Op Sheets / Traveler). Help ensure manufacturing software (ERP/MRP) mirrors CAD data, bill of materials, and method sequence.
Peer review others' work for compliance prior to releasing jobs to production.
Adhere to engineering change management (ECO/ECR/ECN), control, and documentation standards.
Support real-time troubleshooting of manufacturing issues on the production floor.
Work alongside quality and production teams to evaluate potential non-conforming parts against customer specifications and determine whether to process as-is, rework parts, or scrap component/job.
Collaborate on process cost optimization, including labor, material, set-up, machine, inspection, etc.
Conduct research through webinars, journals, periodicals, and tradeshows, and share lessons learned with the team. Provide training and peer support as the SME to facilitate transfer of knowledge.
Identify inefficiencies in a process; work with the team using lean tools and methodology to improve the process.
Miscellaneous duties as assigned.
cond_0450.requirements:
Associate degree in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, or mechanical engineering preferred.
Certified Manufacturing Engineering through Society of Manufacturing Engineers or progressive work experience commensurate with degree also considered.
10+ Years' experience in manufacturing in a machining or contract manufacturing environment.
Subject expertise to read and enforce Aerospace customer blueprint/GD&T standards, special process specifications, raw material specification, and associated industry standards.
Previous experience with RTX customers such as Collins Aerospace, Hamilton Sundstrand, Pratt & Whitney, preferable. Other OEM such as GE, Kaman, Sikorsky, etc., all considered.
Expertise at developing process sheets in one or more of the following manufacturing methods – multi-axis turning, Swiss screw, turning, multi-axis milling and/or grinding.
Strong knowledge of manufacturing with advanced, difficult to machine, alloys to precision tolerances (0.0001""), and how that applies to manufacturing method, work holding, tooling selection, fixturing, and development of size over the progressive operation sequence.
Demonstrated ability to create 3D models, 2D process sheets and supporting technical data. SolidWorks preferred.
Proficient with database tools for file management and information technology tools for data collection and analysis such as ERP, MRP or PDM systems. [Product name masked] ERP and SolidWorks EPDM a plus.

As an SME, this role peer reviews the work of others, provides troubleshooting support to operations, and makes judgment decisions on the interpretation of customer and industry specifications and standards. When needed, this role develops new advanced manufacturing methods through research of new equipment, technologies, methodologies, work holding, and cutting tools.
cond_0475.responsibilities:
Read and interpret customer specifications for material properties, special processes (finishes, coatings, heat-treatments, etc.), part marking, geometric tolerances (GD&T), and other critical-to-quality features required to manufacture the component.
Create 3D models, 2D operational sheets, and associated technical instructions to manufacture customer components according to specifications.
Work with multiple sources of manufacturing and design data (ERP, MRP, CAD, CAM, CNC, etc.) to develop a complete and fully released engineering technical package for the production floor (e.g., Op Sheets / Traveler). Ensure manufacturing software (ERP/MRP) mirrors CAD data, bill of materials, and method sequence.
Peer review others' work for compliance prior to releasing jobs to production.
Adhere to engineering change management (ECO/ECR/ECN), control, and documentation standards.
Provide real-time troubleshooting of manufacturing issues on the production floor.
Evaluate potential non-conforming parts against customer specifications to determine whether to process as-is, rework, or scrap the component or job.
Optimize process cost and cost components — labor, material, set-up, machine, inspection, etc.
Conduct research through webinars, journals, periodicals, and tradeshows; apply lessons learned to the business. Provide training and knowledge transfer to others as the SME.
Identify inefficiencies in a process; use lean tools and methodology to improve the process.
Miscellaneous duties as assigned.
cond_0475.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
10+ Years of experience in manufacturing in a machining or contract manufacturing environment.
Subject expertise to read and enforce aerospace customer blueprint/GD&T standards, special process specifications, raw material specifications, and associated industry standards.
Expertise in developing process sheets in one or more of the following manufacturing methods: multi-axis turning, Swiss screw, turning, multi-axis milling, and/or grinding.
Strong knowledge of manufacturing with advanced, difficult-to-machine alloys to precision tolerances (0.0001""), and how that applies to manufacturing method, work holding, tooling selection, fixturing, and development of size over the progressive operation sequence.
Demonstrated ability to create 3D models, 2D process sheets, and supporting technical data.
Proficient with database tools for file management and information technology tools for data collection and analysis such as ERP, MRP, or PDM systems.
Preferred Requirements
Associate degree in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, or mechanical engineering.
Certified Manufacturing Engineer through the Society of Manufacturing Engineers, or progressive work experience commensurate with a degree.
Previous experience with RTX customers such as Collins Aerospace, Hamilton Sundstrand, or Pratt & Whitney. Other OEMs such as GE, Kaman, or Sikorsky also considered.
SolidWorks proficiency.
Experience with [Product name masked] ERP and SolidWorks EPDM.

cond_0554.intro: The Senior Manufacturing Engineer is a subject matter expert (SME) for manufacturing processes of precision machined components. This role is responsible for the development of manufacturing methods and operation sheets created through the translation of customer technical data, specifications, and contracts. As a SME, this role will peer review the work of others, provide troubleshooting support to operations, and make judgement decisions as it pertains to the interpretation of customer/industry specification and standards. When needed this role will develop new advanced manufacturing methods through research of new equipment, technologies, methodologies, work holding and latest cutting tools. Most people become stronger in this work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0554.responsibilities:
Read and interpret customer specifications for material properties, special processes (finishes, coatings, heat-treatments, etc.), part marking, geometric tolerances (GD&T), and other critical to quality features to manufacture the component.
Create 3D models, 2D operational sheets and associated technical instructions to manufacture customer components according to specifications.
Work with multiple sources of manufacturing and design data (ERP, MRP, CAD, CAM, CNC, etc.) to develop a complete and fully released engineering technical package to production floor (e.g.: Op Sheets / Traveler). Ensure manufacturing software (ERP/MRP) mirrors CAD data, bill of materials, and method sequence.
Peer review of others work for compliance prior to release jobs to production.
Adhere to engineering change management (ECO/ECR/ECN), control, and documentation standards.
Real-time troubleshooting manufacturing issues on production floor.
Evaluate potential non-conforming parts against customer specifications to make the necessary judge call to process as-is, rework parts, or scrap component/job.
Optimize process cost, and costs components - labor, material, set-up, machine, inspection, etc.
Conduct research through webinars, journals, periodicals, tradeshows, and apply lessons learn to the business. Provide training and peer support as the SME to provide a transfer of knowledge.
Identify inefficiencies in a process; use leans tools and methodology to improve a process.
Miscellaneous duties as assigned.
cond_0554.requirements:
Associate degree in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, or mechanical engineering preferred.
Certified Manufacturing Engineering through Society of Manufacturing Engineers or progressive work experience commensurate with degree also considered.
10+ Years' experience in manufacturing in a machining or contract manufacturing environment.
Subject expertise to read and enforce Aerospace customer blueprint/GD&T standards, special process specifications, raw material specification, and associated industry standards.
Previous experience with RTX customers such as Collins Aerospace, Hamilton Sundstrand, Pratt & Whitney, preferable. Other OEM such as GE, Kaman, Sikorsky, etc., all considered.
Expertise at developing process sheets in one or more of the following manufacturing methods – multi-axis turning, Swiss screw, turning, multi-axis milling and/or grinding.
Strong knowledge of manufacturing with advanced, difficult to machine, alloys to precision tolerances (0.0001""), and how that applies to manufacturing method, work holding, tooling selection, fixturing, and development of size over the progressive operation sequence.
Demonstrated ability to create 3D models, 2D process sheets and supporting technical data. SolidWorks preferred.
Proficient with database tools for file management and information technology tools for data collection and analysis such as ERP, MRP or PDM systems. [Product name masked] ERP and SolidWorks EPDM a plus.
